response.overview: Webshow 'Bunch Of Friends' hosts a survival Hunger Games style game in Minecraft, inviting fellow content creators including Dax Flame, Weston Koury, and Grace Reiter. The winners of the competition were prized with posting their own video to the 'Bunch Of Friends' YouTube channel.
response.tagline: Winner Gets To Post On Our Channel.
